description: Machine-readable capability descriptor for every speech-to-speech provider and model family WaaV registers (plus the cascade, GPT-Live and WaaV Infer native duplex), with the regime, owners, verbs, lifecycle and release each one gets in the full-duplex interaction plan. Built from W6-providers-endpoints.md sections 3.2, 3.3, 3.4.3, 3.9, 3.14, 3.16 to 3.18 as aligned with INTEGRATION_DECISIONS.md sections 1 to 11 and Addenda A to C (A2 items 1, 2, 6 to 8 and 10 change this file); vendor facts from verify/ (wins) then web/. regime_resolve.py is the executable specification over this file; every 'expected' block is recomputed and checked by its self-test.
